notes: attempt-1 was exploratory (inspected airframe_data.dta and engine_data.dta, counted samples; no RESULT lines). Final: OLS with heteroskedasticity-robust SEs (fixest, vcov='hetero'). Airframes restricted to fighters and bombers, 1918-1935. Two-piece linear spline in year with a knot at 1926 (sp1=min(year,1926), sp2=max(year-1926,0); each coefficient is a segment slope, like Stata mkspline). Table 1 cols 1-2: US only, log wing load / log max speed on the spline plus a constant. Cols 3-4: pooled US+UK on spline, spline x US, US dummy and constant; the spline x US coefficients are the US slopes relative to the UK. Table 4 col 1: US engines from engine_data.dta (85 obs, all of them), log hp per lb on the spline, a liquid-cooled dummy and a constant. Sample sizes match the paper (116/174/165/233/85), as do the SEs. I compared the final RESULT values with the claims; all agree to the reported precision, and the script was not changed afterwards, so no claim attempt is recorded.
